document.business_rules:
1. Begin with no visit mode, time, or attendee-notification approval. In person is available; Video is available only when allowVideo is true. Modes are single selection.
2. Times are displayed in caller order. A time is enabled only when it is available and supports the selected mode. Choosing another mode preserves the selected time only if that time remains available and compatible; otherwise it clears the time. Choosing a time selects exactly one. Any actual mode/time change clears notification approval.
3. Move appointment requires a selected available compatible time and Notify the attendee selected. The summary uses 'Video'/'In person'/'No visit mode', then ' · ', then the selected time label or 'No time selected'.
4. Successful submission emits exactly one 'reschedule|{entityId}|{in_person or video}|{slotId}', then locks the offer. All other decision taps emit zero events.
5. Same-entity replacement preserves an allowed chosen mode and a still available compatible chosen time; invalid choices clear. Notification approval and recorded status always clear. A changed entityId clears mode, time, approval, and recorded status, including reused slot IDs. Replacement emits no callback.
6. The component requests an appointment move locally; actual calendar mutation and app navigation are outside scope.

measurementSources.palette: Stock Reply ui/theme/Color.kt, light palette, lines 23–57; iOS adopts these explicit component colors because AlertToast.AlertStyle accepts arbitrary SwiftUI Color.
measurementSources.androidTypography: Stock Reply ui/theme/Type.kt titleLarge (22sp,600,28sp line height) and bodyLarge (16sp,400,24sp line height).
measurementSources.iosTypography: Independent design choice: system font, fixed 22pt semibold title, 16pt regular body at approved Large Dynamic Type; visual intent only, no computed SwiftUI font claim.
measurementSources.spacing: Independent design choice, informed by AlertToast.banner VStack leading/spacing10/cornerRadius10 and ReplyEmailListItem Column padding20. This design explicitly fixes its own 16/12/8 rhythm and 16/8 radii, rather than claiming those are upstream defaults.
measurementSources.shape: Stock Reply Shapes.kt supports 8dp small and 16dp medium; iOS adopts explicit matching pt design values.

scope.closed_shape: One eager finite vertical production component. No internal scroll, overlays, asynchronous state, external data, or full app navigation.
scope.fixture_domain: Assessment covers the exact independently sealed family and action prefixes. The reusable public schema supports up to4 data rows per group; unbounded future caller inputs are not certified.
scope.host: 390x600 logical viewport; host inset16 horizontal and24 top; Android density2.75 and explicit paparazzi-float32-screen-config-v1.

obligations.clause: All supplied and computed business text is current and exact.
Native disabled/selected facts obey published business decisions.
Exact tap event intervals require demonstrated successful original native dispatch; blocked taps never prove quiet behavior.
Same-entity revalidation and changed-entity reset are distinct and callback-silent.
Typography follows sourced native or qualitative platform intent.
Full variable-length vertical content wraps, fits and preserves separation/insets.
Component opaque fills match approved suitable pixel regions; primary ink is readable.
Primary control accessibility-box height is48pt/dp; no physical OS hit-area claim.
Visible selection marks agree with native selected facts.
Panel and option corner shape follow independent annotated references.
